nodes.text: RNA-seq Differential Transcript Usage (rnaseqDTU). Bioc Workflow `rnaseqDTU` analog: quantify transcripts (Salmon), import via tximport, then + DEXSeq + stageR for differential transcript usage with FDR control.

RNA-seq + Epigenomic Integration (fluentGenomics). Bioc Workflow `fluentGenomics` analog: integrate RNA-seq differential genes with ATAC-seq accessibility regions and ChIP-seq TF binding peaks, link peaks to genes via + .

Microarray Normalization Method Comparison (ExpressionNormalizationWorkflow). Bioc Workflow ExpressionNormalizationWorkflow analog: read raw microarray CEL/IDAT files, normalize with multiple methods (RMA, vsn, lumi, ComBat), compare normalization quality via PCA and variance estimation. For normalization quality comparison and method selection ONLY — NOT for differential expression statistical testing. For differential expression analysis from a normalized microarray count matrix, use nf-core/differentialabundance.
Run a complete rare disease workup — I have WES and RNA-seq

BioMate: Subworkflow Sprint 3 — Pseudotime + RNA velocity from single-cell data Runs two orthogonal trajectory methods in parallel: — graph-based pseudotime (R / Monocle3) — RNA velocity (Python / scVelo) Both processes accept the same AnnData h5ad input but are. 2-step pipeline: → . Inputs: csv, h5ad. Outputs: anndata, csv, h5ad, png. Key parameters: adata_h5ad, monocle_cluster, root_cell, velocity_mode.

Perturb-seq single-cell CRISPR guide assignment to individual cell barcodes | guide assignment and single-cell demultiplexing from Perturb-seq CRISPR direct-capture guide sequencing data → cell-to-sgRNA assignment table and filtered count matrix

Perturb-seq hit calling and differential perturbation effect analysis against non-targeting controls | statistical hit calling comparing perturbed cells to non-targeting control cells across single-cell expression profiles → ranked perturbation gene hits and effect sizes

Perturbation state representation learning using scVI and scANVI latent embedding | deep generative representation learning of single-cell perturbation states using scVI and scANVI conditioned on guide or target labels → latent space embedding and perturbation manifold
Find tumor-reactive T cells in this scRNA-seq + predict neoantigens

Run RNA-seq analysis and differential expression

Nanostring GeoMx DSP Analysis (GeoMxWorkflows). Bioc Workflow `GeoMxWorkflows` analog: read Nanostring GeoMx DSP NanoStringGeoMxSet, segment-level QC, Q3 normalization, mixed-model linear DE across regions of interest.

IDAT → Normalisation → Differential Methylation → Gene Enrichment. EPIC/450K array methylation from IDAT — minfi load + functional normalisation, DSS differential methylation, missMethyl gene-set enrichment. Use when you want the DSS-based differential-methylation + enrichment wrapper chain. Also applicable to bismark bisulfite coverage from nf-core/methylseq.

Illumina 450k/EPIC Methylation Array DMR Analysis (methylationArrayAnalysis). Bioc Workflow `methylationArrayAnalysis` analog: read IDAT files via minfi, QC, normalize (SWAN or noob), call DMPs (limma), DMRs (DMRcate), gene-set test (missMethyl).

Public RNA-seq Reanalysis (recountWorkflow). Bioc Workflow `recountWorkflow` analog: pull uniformly-processed counts from recount2/3 for a study (e.g., SRP), scale counts by read length, run DESeq2 DE with technical replicate handling.
FDA Phase II to Phase III dose justification brief
RNA-seq differential expression analysis | differential gene expression analysis on bulk RNA-seq data → ranked differentially expressed gene signature

Match transcriptional signature against perturbational drug profile databases (LINCS/CMap) | transcriptional signature matching against perturbational expression databases (LINCS L1000/CMap) using connectivity scoring → ranked drug candidates
Run Voyager spatial ESDA on this Visium dataset

Estimate human PK parameters from preclinical rat, mouse, or dog data using species scaling | allometric inter-species scaling from animal PK parameters (rat, mouse, dog) → predicted human clearance and volume of distribution

Run full PBPK simulation with compartmental model and organ-specific clearance including special population impairment submodels | physiologically-based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) simulation with organ-specific clearances and renal/hepatic impairment submodels → concentration-time profiles and tissue distribution

Perform Monte Carlo sampling for variability characterization and special population dose projection | Monte Carlo population pharmacokinetic simulation for inter-individual variability → virtual patient exposure distributions and dosing recommendations
test compound effect over time at 0, 6, 24, and 72 hours

Population pharmacokinetic (PopPK) estimation pipeline with NONMEM primary execution and automatic nlmixr2 (R) fallback when NONMEM is unavailable. BYOL (Bring Your Own License) pattern: -- If NONMEM_HOME and NONMEM_LICENSE_FILE are set → run NONMEM nmfe75/nmfe74 -- Otherwise → fall back to nlmixr2 open-source R implementation Pipeline Steps: 1. -- Validate NONMEM-format dataset structure (ID, TIME, DV, etc.) 2. NONMEM_CTL_GENERATE -- Generate NO
Validate SMILES input file with one SMILES and ID per line | validation and chemical standardization of SMILES input files with associated molecule identifiers
RDKit RECAP decomposition of molecules into scaffold and R-groups | molecular fragmentation using RDKit RECAP decomposition into core scaffolds and R-group substituents
mmpdb property deltas analysis for fragment swaps | matched molecular pair compilation and property delta calculation using mmpdb for fragment replacements

Rank novel scaffolds by frequency, drug-likeness, and synthetic accessibility (SA) score | prioritization and ranking of novel scaffolds based on occurrence frequency, drug-likeness filters, and synthetic accessibility scores
Validate gene expression matrix and clinical metadata | data validation and quality control of bulk RNA-seq gene expression matrix and matched clinical metadata

Run limma-voom differential expression analysis with covariates and empirical Bayes moderation | differential gene expression modeling using voom transformation, linear model with clinical covariates, and eBayes moderation → topTable of logFC and adjusted p-values

Perform GSVA/ssGSEA pathway signature scoring using MSigDB hallmark gene sets | single-sample gene set enrichment analysis (GSVA/ssGSEA) on MSigDB hallmark collection (50 gene sets) → per-sample pathway scores and top enriched pathways per group

Phase A: Cardiac ion channel liability and off-target safety screening (in silico hERG, Nav1.5, Cav1.2 inhibition profiling) | in silico profiling and QSAR/docking estimation of compound cardiac ion channel inhibition (hERG, Nav1.5, Cav1.2 IC50) and secondary target safety binding → ion channel inhibition profile and liability risk scores

Phase B: In silico cardiovascular system simulation (hemodynamic, blood pressure, heart rate, and QTc prolongation modeling) | biophysical cardiac cell electrophysiology and hemodynamic simulation (CiPA ventricular action potential modeling, QTc prolongation, MAP, and heart rate effects) → simulated ECG waveforms and proarrhythmic/hemodynamic risk metrics

Phase C: Central nervous system (CNS) and respiratory safety simulation (neurobehavioral FOB/Irwin battery and plethysmography dynamics) | predictive QSAR and mechanistic modeling of neurobehavioral parameters (locomotor activity, coordination, temperature) and respiratory ventilation dynamics (tidal volume, respiratory rate, minute volume) → simulated functional observational battery and pulmonary safety parameters

Phase D: Exposure-margin calculation and integrated ICH S7A core battery safety report | integration of core battery findings against anticipated therapeutic clinical unbound exposure (Cmax,free) → therapeutic safety margins (IC50/Cmax), regulatory traffic-light matrix, and ICH S7A compliance summary report
